project.name: common-credit
project.description: Shared party-credit rules: an append-only signed ledger, a redemption capped at the balance so it can never overdraw, and a cached balance refreshed after every write. Storage and the cached-balance owner come from a CreditStore SPI, so POS store credit (Customer) and school fee credit (Student) share one set of rules without sharing a table. Holds NO @Entity.
